d:
Snapdragon X2 Plus ka real-world review: performance, battery life aur 80 TOPS AI, tested on the Lenovo Yoga Slim 7x. Kya ARM-based Windows laptops ab finally ready hain? Is video mein jaaniye X2 Plus mein kya naya hai aur ye laptop kiske liye bana hai.
Lenovo Yoga Slim 7x – Key Specs:
• Processor: Snapdragon X2 Plus (6-core, up to 4GHz)
• RAM: 16GB LPDDR5X (soldered)
• Storage: 512GB PCIe 4.0 NVMe SSD
• Display: 14" WUXGA OLED, 16:10, 60Hz, 600 nits peak, Dolby Vision
• Certifications: Eyesafe, TÜV Low Blue Light
• Camera: 9MP IR camera with Windows Hello
